counting: Forty additional root findings after NEW-AUDIT-30. Distinguish reproduced bugs from measured optimizations; do not recount prior findings or hypothetical issues. Read each bounded implementation before editing it.

findings.title: Timed Google RRULE UNTIL fails at a midnight DST gap or fold
findings.evidence: Havana midnight gap/fold; Google export throws before fix
findings.titleJa: Google出力の繰り返し終了日が夏時間の切り替えで計算できない

findings.title: Shared local all-day availability becomes unknown at a midnight DST gap
findings.evidence: Havana all-day expected 1380 busy minutes returned unknown
findings.titleJa: 共有推奨計算で終日予定のある日を取得不能と扱う

findings.title: Personal planning silently treats unresolved recurring DST appointments as free
findings.evidence: Weekly New York 02:30 occurrence during spring gap had no busy coverage
findings.titleJa: 未解決の夏時間の予定を個人家事の空き時間と扱う

findings.title: Repeated Google import clock formatter construction
findings.evidence: 100 imports: 200 clock formatter constructors reduced to 1; same date/minutes
findings.titleJa: Google予定の取り込みで時計フォーマッターを毎回生成する

findings.title: Calendar reads transport complete remote descriptions for three metadata fields
findings.evidence: One 4000-character note: observed relevant rows 4637 bytes reduced to 609 bytes
findings.titleJa: 表示に不要なGoogle予定の長い本文までSQLiteから読み出す

findings.title: Explicit discard from an older calendar editor deletes a newer persisted draft
findings.evidence: Concurrent same-scope draft overwritten by old discard; now CAS refusal preserves newer draft
findings.titleJa: 古い編集画面の破棄操作が新しい下書きを消す

findings.title: Expired one-off holiday prevents future heavy chores from finding a valid slot
findings.evidence: Historical holiday outside placement range reproduced fallback despite available time
findings.titleJa: 過去の単発休日が今後の重い家事の配置を妨げる

findings.title: Adaptive capacity and placement rescan every day and every allowed band
findings.evidence: 365-day input: boundary reads 365083 before; nearby interval searches now pass less than 30000 with identical recommendation
findings.titleJa: 家事の配分時に全日付・全時間帯を繰り返し走査する

findings.title: Discard during an in-flight autosave leaves raw form behind committed baseline
findings.evidence: Saved n=2 with discard during write previously displayed n=1 while reporting no draft
findings.titleJa: 保存中に入力を破棄すると画面と保存済み値がずれる

findings.title: Reversed pre-debounce edits still persist unchanged settings
findings.evidence: Return to original value: one write reduced to zero; in-flight reversal still writes both
findings.titleJa: 入力を元へ戻しても不要な保存・再計算が走る

findings.title: Calendar database change exposes prior database snapshot while reading new DB
findings.evidence: Switch with stalled next read reproduced previous private calendar title
findings.titleJa: DBを切り替えると前のDBの予定が一時表示される

findings.title: Changing group-draft visibility loses retained drafts and rereads unchanged DB
findings.evidence: Toggle could not reveal existing shared draft before another full read; now instant retained projection
findings.titleJa: 共有下書きの表示切り替えで保存済み下書きが消えて見える

findings.title: Legacy weather resolution renormalizes every bundled municipality per read
findings.evidence: 20 settings resolutions: 38300 normalizations reduced to 20
findings.titleJa: 地域設定の照合で全自治体名を繰り返し正規化する

findings.title: Weekly calendar headers enumerate all occurrences even with no hidden dates
findings.evidence: One year weekly labels: 54 label reads reduced to 2; hidden-date behavior retained
findings.titleJa: 非表示の収集日がなくても1年分の収集回を列挙する

findings.title: Appliance reanalysis drops adaptive execution-window and drying overrides
findings.evidence: Explicit userWindowRadiusDays=4 disappeared after reanalysis; now retained with local drying choice
findings.titleJa: 家電の再解析で本人の実施期間幅・干し方が失われる

findings.title: Completion-only cards recompute a frozen recording day in the current region
findings.evidence: New York November 6 completion vanished from that day after Tokyo projection
findings.titleJa: 地域変更後に記録済みの完了日が別の日へ移る

findings.title: Upcoming cards scan the complete completion history for every entry
findings.evidence: 800 exact records: 321200 outcome reads reduced below 5000; legacy precedence maintained
findings.titleJa: 今後の家事一覧で各家事から全完了履歴を検索する

findings.title: Calendar sub-pickers use stale render state for immediate confirmation and allow duplicate custom navigation
findings.evidence: Real native callbacks before repaint reproduced old year/month and double custom navigation
findings.titleJa: 予定の補助Pickerが直前の選択を取りこぼす

findings.title: A throwing calendar display subscriber prevents healthy subscribers from seeing committed preferences
findings.evidence: Throwing first observer caused select to throw and second listener was never called
findings.titleJa: 表示設定の通知先1つの例外で他の画面更新が止まる

findings.title: Initial viewport expansion range is dropped before Google observer effect initialization
findings.evidence: Request before passive observer setup disappeared; latest early range now delivered once
findings.titleJa: Google監視の準備前に要求した最初の表示範囲が失われる

findings.title: Shared optimistic Undo retains early completion day instead of reopening recommended date
findings.evidence: Undo override false kept October 28 round on October 27; now follows effective state
findings.titleJa: 早めに完了した共有家事を取り消しても日付が戻らない

findings.title: Shared calendar hidden completion status leaks through a changed row date
findings.evidence: Non-owner status-hidden view moved row to early performed day after completion
findings.titleJa: 他担当者の完了を隠す表示でも日付変化から状態が分かる

findings.title: Deferred private Calendar outbox checks transfer full ciphertext before checking backoff
findings.evidence: 20 deferred checks: full ciphertext reads reduced from 20 to 0; force still verifies ciphertext
findings.titleJa: 再送待機中も本人用Calendarの暗号文全体を読み出す

findings.title: Unchanged personal PDF reads repeat bounded but expensive full base64 and SHA verification
findings.evidence: 20 unchanged reads: verification calls reduced from 20 to 1; modified content still rejected
findings.titleJa: 同じ保存済みPDFを開くたびに全内容を再検証する

findings.title: Shared appliance copy batch repeatedly normalizes every existing product identity
findings.evidence: 30 incoming and 30 existing products: 2790 normalizations reduced below 300; same 30 appliance IDs
findings.titleJa: 家電の一括保存で既存製品の同一性を何度も照合する

findings.title: Late manual chunks do not invalidate a completed native appliance-retention token
findings.evidence: Appliance and manifest copied without PDF; final chunk arrived but no retry before fix
findings.titleJa: PDFの最後の断片が遅れて届くと個人側への保持を再試行しない

findings.title: Shared calendar projection repeats event/category canonical digest requests
findings.evidence: 100 events with common category: 300 digest/canonicalization requests reduced to 101, identical IDs
findings.titleJa: 共有予定のID・同じ分類のIDを重複して導出する

findings.title: Google settings accept responses from a replaced runtime and retain prior database controls
findings.evidence: Delayed old shared read overwrote new account, and personal old calendar remained while new database read was pending; both reproduced before fix
findings.titleJa: 切り替え前のGoogle接続設定が後から現在の表示へ混ざる

findings.title: Native appliance admission uses the last rendered product name instead of the latest text
findings.evidence: Immediate native text and submit callbacks produced no onAdd; latest trimmed name now reaches one registration
findings.titleJa: 製品名入力直後の確定で最新の文字列が渡らない

findings.title: Long-cycle calendar preview replays every missed cycle
findings.evidence: Ten-year 90-day preview: 45 predictions reduced to 1; alternating uses 2, same adopted dates and immutable input
findings.titleJa: 長周期家事の次回表示まで過去の周期を逐次計算する

findings.title: An immediate autosave edit in a completion microtask is stranded behind a settled writer
findings.evidence: Saved observer microtask queued n=2 but only n=1 was persisted before fix
findings.titleJa: 保存完了直後の追加編集が未処理のまま残る

findings.title: Chore history navigation leaves an invalid unsaved numeric draft
findings.evidence: Invalid radius x still navigated to history; now stays until corrected
findings.titleJa: 不正な数値の下書きを残したまま家事の履歴へ移動できる

findings.title: Tasks response cache saves each row with a separate SQLite bridge call
findings.evidence: 100 returned Tasks: 100 staging inserts reduced to one; exact cached list retained
findings.titleJa: 取得したTasksを1件ごとにSQLiteへ保存する

findings.title: Dense calendar timeline lane assignment performs quadratic scans
findings.evidence: 2000 overlapping events: 1999000 linear probes reduced to zero, same lane assignments
findings.titleJa: 大量に重なる予定の横位置を二重ループで探索する

findings.title: Out-of-range batch Retry-After masks the original provider failure
findings.evidence: Retry-After 1e14 caused RangeError and discarded a valid sibling 3600-second backoff
findings.titleJa: 範囲外のRetry-Afterで本来のGoogleエラーと待機時間が失われる

findings.title: Calendar viewport resizing regenerates unchanged civil row geometry
findings.evidence: 521-week window reuses its day/month geometry on height changes, returning isolated day arrays
findings.titleJa: 画面サイズ変更のたびにカレンダー全日付を再計算する

findings.title: Retained chore editor ignores new global frequency mode or adopted cadence
findings.evidence: Balanced 7 to relaxed 14 stayed at 7; settled editors now follow mode/cadence changes, while invalid drafts and same-mode conflict baselines remain intact
findings.titleJa: 保持した家事設定が新しい頻度モード・採用周期へ追従しない

findings.title: Waste icon color label and search repeatedly normalize the entire alias table
findings.evidence: 400 lookups now normalize inputs once each while retaining aliases and search ranking
findings.titleJa: ゴミ名・アイコン・色・検索で全別名を繰り返し正規化する

findings.title: Daily digest resolves zoned times for days without reminder content
findings.evidence: 31 zoned fire-time resolutions reduced to 3 for three real reminders, and zero when empty
findings.titleJa: 通知のない日まで時差を含む通知時刻を計算する

findings.title: A valid custom waste name matching an Object prototype member crashes calendar rendering
findings.evidence: Accepted constructor / __proto__ labels caused TypeError at compact-name replacement; own-property lookup now renders them literally
findings.titleJa: 特殊な独自ゴミ名でカレンダー表示が例外終了する
